candidates.description: This feature vector represents quantifying words and indefinite pronouns denoting quantity across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents German verb forms across various tenses, moods, and numbers.
This feature vector represents additive or inclusive adverbial connectors across multiple European languages.
This feature vector represents abstract mental constructs, theoretical principles, and foundational ideas.
This vector represents the concept of universality or totality, encompassing words for "all" and "every" across multiple languages.
This vector represents transitional logical connectors and conjunctive adverbs used to indicate consequence, contrast, or sequential flow across multiple languages.
This vector is related to sub-word tokens beginning with the letters 'K' or 'k'.
This vector represents past-tense action verbs indicating completed events or established states.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens related to the word "grade" and its morphological variations, spelling fragments, or closely associated educational terms.
This vector represents formalized methods, practices, and institutional rules governing behavior and instruction.
